Despite the Nasdaq-100 being at an all-time high, historical data suggests that investing for the long term, even through market volatility, can lead to substantial returns. The article argues that the QQQ ETF remains a good buy for long-term investors aiming for compounding returns.

title: The Truth About Alphabet Inc. (Class A): Is This Stock Still a No-Brainer or Totally Overhyped?
summary: This article examines whether Alphabet Inc. (Class A) is still a worthwhile investment, considering the hype around big tech and AI. It analyzes the company's strong product grip in search, YouTube, and Android, its position in the AI war, and its price-performance relative to rivals. The author concludes that Alphabet is a foundational long-term investment rather than a short-term hype stock.

title: Exclusive | JPMorgan Chase Reaches Deal to Take Over Apple Credit Card - WSJ
summary: JPMorgan Chase has reached an agreement to take over Apple's credit-card program from Goldman Sachs. This move further solidifies JPMorgan's position in the credit-card market and concludes Goldman Sachs' venture into consumer lending. JPMorgan, the largest bank in the U.S., will now become the issuer for Apple's credit card, which has about $20 billion in balances.

title: New Year Blues For Apple: GOOGL Market Cap Surges Past iPhone Maker's After 7 Long Years, Powered By AI Push
summary: Alphabet Inc. has surpassed Apple Inc. in market capitalization for the first time in seven years, reaching $3.89 trillion, driven by strong AI development and the Gemini 3 AI model. This shift highlights investors' increasing preference for AI-focused companies, as Apple's stock has declined for six consecutive days amidst skepticism about its delayed AI functionalities. While analysts are wary of Apple's near-term prospects, retail investors remain optimistic about a potential rebound.

title: Why Globalstar Stock Crashed Today
summary: Globalstar stock crashed 9.6% after a recent surge, despite a positive analyst report the previous day. The decline appears to be linked to a Scotiabank report downgrading rival AST SpaceMobile, which highlighted the superior capabilities and rapid deployment of SpaceX's Starlink, posing a significant competitive threat to both AST and Globalstar. The article suggests Globalstar, which has struggled with profitability, may face an uphill battle against SpaceX's "unstoppable" expansion.

title: Goldman Sachs : Announces Agreement to Transition Apple Card Program to Chase
summary: Goldman Sachs announced an agreement to transition its Apple Card program and associated accounts to Chase, completing the narrowing of its consumer business focus. The transaction is expected to increase Goldman Sachs' fourth-quarter 2025 earnings per share by $0.46, reflecting a significant release of loan loss reserves partially offset by revenue reductions and expenses. The transition is anticipated to take approximately 24 months, during which Goldman Sachs will continue to operate the program.
